## Featured product

- [Heated Shawl – Neck & Shoulder Warmer for Winter](https://haowordtool.myshopify.com/pages/heated-shawl-neck-shoulder-warmer-for-winter): USB-powered heated shawl sold by our own store. Price $81.99. 8 heating zones, 3 heat levels (High 55°C / Medium 45°C / Low 35°C), powered by 5V/2A USB (10W, power bank not included). Size 150 × 80 cm, weight 0.7 kg, fabric 68% cotton / 29% polyester / 3% spandex. FCC Part 15B compliant. Wipe-clean only, do not machine wash. Free standard shipping (US warehouse, about 8 days average delivery); express shipping $15.

Covers the 5 things to check before buying a heated shawl (power source, heating zones and levels, fabric and care, size and fit, shipping and returns), with full specifications of our heated shawl.
